scope: Charge pending/orphan POLYLINE owner-map value and conservative node storage into the existing bounded staging ledger; leave unordered-map bucket arrays and implementation-specific allocator retention explicitly outside the model.

method.kind: Focused implementation slice with generated in-memory rollback and retry coverage

implementation.pendingParent: Preflight the conservative owner value/node charge before declared-child index construction; retain it in PendingPolylineState::retainedBytes and let existing rollback/commit/terminalization paths release it.
implementation.childFirstOrphan: Preflight and charge the owner entry before vertex staging; preserve its charge when vector capacity changes and release it on adoption or terminalization.
implementation.wholeLedgerValidation: Reconstruct both map owner charges independently and compare them against retainedBytes and the aggregate 256 MiB model.
